summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier families from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with rapidly improving open-weight models from DeepSeek, Meta, Alibaba, and Mistral capturing cost-sensitive developers. Enterprise adoption increasingly flows through cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, which substantially amplifies real-world usage beyond direct-API numbers. Pricing has fallen dramatically, with open-weight models now delivering near-frontier performance at a fraction of the cost.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely integrated model across developer tooling and is available through Azure OpenAI, giving it massive enterprise aggregator reach beyond its already dominant direct-API volume.
models.best_for: General-purpose multimodal applications and production chat assistants

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released Feb 17, 2026, matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; heavily adopted for coding and available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure, boosting enterprise reach.
models.best_for: Agentic coding workflows and enterprise software development

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: A context-window leader widely consumed through Google Vertex AI and integrated into Google Workspace, giving it strong enterprise aggregator adoption.
models.best_for: Long-document analysis and large-context enterprise workloads

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B-parameter MoE (37B active) reasoning specialist and the cheapest frontier-class model at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens, driving enormous open-weight download volume on HuggingFace.
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive reasoning and mathematical problem solving

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: The high-throughput, low-cost sibling to Gemini 2.5 Pro, heavily used for high-volume production tasks and available through Google Vertex AI aggregator infrastructure.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: A leading open-weight general model with strong HuggingFace download numbers, widely self-hosted by developers seeking frontier performance at minimal cost.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and broadly available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Google Vertex AI, giving it very high real-world adoption.
strengths: Available across all major cloud aggregators

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released Feb 5, 2026 as Anthropic's top-tier model for complex tasks; available via AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, driving high-value enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning and high-stakes enterprise coding tasks

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: A widely adopted European model available on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI, popular for enterprises with data-sovereignty requirements.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A top-performing open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads, especially popular in Asia and among cost-sensitive self-hosting developers.
models.best_for: Open-weight self-hosted deployments and multilingual applications
